name: LockSampleDistanceToInputSpacing
definition: A correction technique to equalize the ray sampling distance used by GPU and CPU mappers to reduce sampling seams. It involves enabling the `LockSampleDistanceToInputSpacing` mode in the GPU mapper, which was previously only available in the CPU mapper (`vtkFixedPointVolumeRayCastMapper`).
summary: LockSampleDistanceToInputSpacing is a volume rendering correction that locks ray sampling distance to input data spacing, equalizing CPU and GPU implementations to reduce visible sampling seams.
